title: Trump threatens EU with 'substantial TARIFF' for 'ROBBING' U.S. tech giants
summary_full: Trump on Truth Social railed against the European Union's new fine on Google and prior penalties against U.S. tech giants Apple, Meta and Amazon.
summary_public: Trump on Truth Social railed against the European Union's new fine on Google and prior penalties against U.S. tech giants Apple, Meta and Amazon.
